typeRule.fabricate: Make an existing item (or a finished invention). Materials: one Price Category lower (Super Luxury: half the price). Failure: start over, materials kept.
typeRule.invent: Pitch the function and how it works; the GM sets the Price Category (Expensive+) and writes the rules. Check at halfway; failure: back to the drawing board. Then fabricate it.
typeRule.upgrade: One upgrade per item. Materials: the item's own Price Category (vehicles: Very Expensive). Failure: start over, item and materials fine.
typeRule.repair: Field Expertise adds its rank. DV and time follow the item's Price Category unless the GM says otherwise. No Workshop slots.
